father_game_night_greeting_1.direction: Cheerful, slightly awkward, playful and affectionate.
lines: Ah, there you are! Welcome to game night, kiddo! Your Other Mother has brought out all sorts of wonderful games. I hope you're ready for a little friendly competition!

father_game_night_greeting_2.direction: Cheerful, slightly awkward, playful and affectionate.
lines: Ah, perfect timing! We've got the whole family together, and I've been looking forward to this all evening. Come on, grab a seat!

father_game_night_cards_rules.direction: Cheerful, slightly awkward, playful and affectionate.
lines: Right then! Match the color or number on the card in the middle. If you can't play anything, draw a card. First one to get rid of all their cards wins. Sounds simple enough, doesn't it?

father_game_night_thread_rules.direction: Cheerful, slightly awkward, playful and affectionate.
lines: Ah, this one's a team game! You and Wybie are against your Other Mother and me. Take turns dropping your buttons into the board. First team to get four in a row wins!

father_game_night_tower_rules.direction: Cheerful, slightly awkward, playful and affectionate.
lines: Now, we each take turns pulling one little block out of the tower. Just be careful where you pull from, because if the whole thing falls down on your turn, you've lost!

father_game_night_mouseboard_rules.direction: Cheerful, slightly awkward, playful and affectionate.
lines: Ah, ready for a race? Roll the dice, move your little mouse along the board, and try to reach the finish first. Watch out for the special spaces, though. They can change everything!

father_game_night_flick_rules.direction: Cheerful, slightly awkward, playful and affectionate.
lines: Right! Aim your button toward the scoring rings and give it a good flick. The closer you land to the center, the more points you get. We'll each have three turns. Highest score wins!

father_game_night_charades_rules.direction: Cheerful, slightly awkward, playful and affectionate.
lines: Ah, charades! One of us acts something out without speaking, and everyone else tries to guess what it is. You'd think Wybie would have a rather unfair advantage, wouldn't you? Ha!

father_game_night_cards_reaction.direction: Cheerful, slightly awkward, playful and affectionate.
lines: Oh, that's a good move! I was rather hoping you wouldn't notice that card. Hmm. I may have to rethink my strategy.

father_game_night_thread_reaction.direction: Cheerful, slightly awkward, playful and affectionate.
lines: Ah, very clever! I nearly missed what you were doing there. Your Other Mother and I had better pay closer attention!

father_game_night_tower_reaction.direction: Cheerful, slightly awkward, playful and affectionate.
lines: Oh! Oh dear! Did you see that wobble? I don't think I ought to breathe too heavily near this thing.

father_game_night_mouseboard_reaction.direction: Cheerful, slightly awkward, playful and affectionate.
lines: Would you look at that! Your little mouse is making quite the comeback. Mine seems to have forgotten it's supposed to be racing!

father_game_night_flick_reaction.direction: Cheerful, slightly awkward, playful and affectionate.
lines: Ah, splendid shot! That's landed rather close to the middle. I don't suppose you'd mind teaching your old dad how you did that?

father_game_night_charades_reaction.direction: Cheerful, slightly awkward, playful and affectionate.
lines: Ah! I think I've got it! No, wait, perhaps not. Oh dear. Wybie makes this look so much easier than it really is!

father_game_night_finish_1.direction: Cheerful, slightly awkward, playful and affectionate.
lines: Ah, that was wonderful! I don't think I've had that much fun playing games in ages. We really ought to do this more often!

father_game_night_finish_2.direction: Cheerful, slightly awkward, playful and affectionate.
lines: Well, that was quite the evening! Some very clever moves all around, I must say. I think I'll need a little practice before our next game night!
